C4.question: Give me all strains that have the field 'collection' equal to '18' and that have the field 'collectiondate' with a date before '2012'.
C4.sql_query: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE collection = '18' AND ((LENGTH(collectiondate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(collectiondate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 1, 2) < '2012-01-01') OR (LENGTH(collectiondate) = 4 AND collectiondate < '2012'));

C4.question: Give me all strains that have the field 'collection' equal to '18' and that have the field 'collectiondate' with a date before '02-03-1999'.

C4.question: Give me all the strains that have the collection field equal to '18' and that have the collectiondate field with a date after '1999'. I also want the identificationtechnique to be 'ELISA' or 'Bioassay'.
C4.sql_query: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE collection = '18' AND ((LENGTH(collectiondate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(collectiondate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 1, 2) > '1999-12-31') OR (LENGTH(collectiondate) = 4 AND collectiondate > '1999')) AND (identificationtechnique = 'ELISA' OR identificationtechnique = 'Bioassay');

C4.question: Give me all the strains that have the collection field equal to 18 and that have the collectiondate field with a date between 2000 and 2010. I also want the identificationtechnique to be ELISA or Bioassay.

C5.question: Select and count the number of strains, grouping the results by the trasmissionby field.
C5.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*), transmissionby FROM detailedstrain GROUP BY transmissionby;

C5.question: Select and count all the strains that have the 'ineva' field equal to true and group only those that have the same storageconditions. I want you to also show me the storageconditions field.
C5.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*), storageconditions FROM detailedstrain WHERE ineva = TRUE GROUP BY storageconditions;

C5.question: Select and count the number of strains by grouping them based on the transmissionby and storageconditions fields.
C5.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*), transmissionby, storageconditions FROM detailedstrain GROUP BY transmissionby, storageconditions;

C5.question: Select and count all strains that have the ineva field equal to true and group only those that have the same storageconditions. I want it to also show me the storageconditions field and only the groups that have more than 4 examples.
C5.sql_query: SELECT storageconditions, COUNT(*) FROM detailedstrain WHERE ineva = TRUE GROUP BY storageconditions HAVING COUNT(*) > 4;
